content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal provide an easy-to-use interface and seamless integration for online sales, but they come with significant limitations. While Stripe offers a robust API and features for managing subscriptions and invoicing, it excludes a vast number of countries, limiting access for many creators. PayPal presents a familiar option but often holds funds for extended periods, especially following account suspensions, which can last up to 180 days without appeal. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH enables creators to establish their own digital stores with complete ownership and control over their sales process, free from the risks associated with centralized platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal both maintain strict geographical restrictions that prevent users in many countries from accessing their services. Stripe's coverage is limited to only 46 countries out of 195, leaving a vast majority of creators without options. PayPal, while slightly more inclusive, has also been known to restrict access based on various criteria, especially in regions perceived as high-risk. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to empower creators regardless of their location. By leveraging technologies like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, COREMERCH provides a universally accessible solution that eliminates the dependency on traditional payment gateways and empowers creators to operate independently.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing speed and associated fees are critical factors for any digital seller. Stripe and PayPal typically have standard fees that can range from 2.9% plus a fixed fee per transaction, which can add up significantly over time. Moreover, the transaction speed can vary, especially if manual reviews or holds are involved, leading to frustrating delays for creators. In contrast, COREMERCH's infrastructure enables automatic payment processing through NOWPayments with a mere 0.5% fee, ensuring funds are received almost instantly once the payment confirms on-chain. This speed and low-cost structure provide a clear advantage for creators seeking to maximize their earnings and ensure immediate cash flow.
Sovereign commerce ensures your infrastructure is built for independence, not dependency.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

A critical aspect of selling digital products is ensuring complete ownership and control over the sales process. Platforms like Stripe and PayPal often retain rights over user data and transactions, creating an inherent risk for creators. Additionally, they rely on third-party services for automated delivery, which can introduce additional points of failure. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, guarantees full ownership after deployment, with no ongoing fees or dependencies on external platforms. By utilizing tools like Supabase for order storage and Google Drive for file delivery, creators can automate their entire sales process while maintaining absolute control over their content and customer data.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your unique needs as a creator. If you're in a supported country and desire a quick setup, traditional platforms may suffice. However, if you're located in regions with restrictions, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only viable path forward. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH is a recommended choice, providing a complete, tested solution that deploys in just 48 hours. With integrated payment processing and automated delivery, this stack is designed for creators who want to eliminate the risk of service disruptions and secure their financial future.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Eliminate the risk of account suspensions and fund holds with decentralized payment processing.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
